summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (RHEL9, static binaries + systemd unit, firewalld ports 2379/2380 opened), seeded it with application keys under /app/*, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped /var/lib/etcd, ran `member remove` from a surviving quorum of node1+node2 while confirming reads/health stayed up), and replaced it with a working member on the same node3 host via `member add` + ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, restoring a healthy 3/3 cluster with all original keys intact. Then ran the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all three nodes sequentially (native `reboot` via systemd-run timer so the ack returned first), proving changed boot IDs and full post-restart etcd/cluster/data recovery on each node before moving to the next, preserving quorum throughout.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.5.17 static binaries on node1, node2, node3 from GitHub releases
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 (tcp) on all three nodes
Created etcd systemd units and initial 3-member cluster (node1,node2,node3), started as ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=new
Verified all 3 members healthy and wrote 4 application keys under /app/config and /app/service
Captured healthy baseline on node3's own endpoint (health, keys, endpoint status)
Simulated permanent loss of node3 member: stopped/disabled etcd, deleted /var/lib/etcd, confirmed node1+node2 quorum still healthy and serving all keys
Removed dead node3 member (7baaf459f21f2845) via etcdctl member remove from node1
Added new node3 member via etcdctl member add, reconfigured node3 etcd.env with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing and fresh data dir, started etcd
Verified restored 3/3 cluster health, membership (new member ID 5ef59cbc2144a9d for node3), and all original application keys intact from both node1 and node3 endpoints
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes

Sequentially restarted node1, then node2, then node3 via systemd-run scheduled /usr/sbin/reboot (ack returned before disconnect), polled each until exec was available again, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified etcd active + 3/3 cluster health + all keys present after each restart before proceeding to the next node

evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster running with application keys
evidence.summary: endpoint health shows all 3 members true; member list shows node1/node2/node3 started; get /app --prefix returns all 4 seeded application keys

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured on node3 before simulated loss
evidence.summary: node3's own client endpoint reports healthy, returns all app keys, and endpoint status shows normal raft state prior to disruption

evidence.requirement: Node3 member permanently lost, quorum preserved during disruption
evidence.summary: etcd stopped and data dir deleted on node3; node1+node2 (2/3 quorum) confirmed healthy, member list, and full key set still served while node3 was down

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and replacement member added/started on node3
evidence.summary: member remove of old node3 ID 7baaf459f21f2845; member add creates new unstarted member 5ef59cbc2144a9d for node3 peer URL; etcd started successfully on node3 joining as existing cluster member

evidence.requirement: Cluster restored to 3 healthy members with existing keys intact after replacement
evidence.summary: endpoint health true for all 3 endpoints, member list shows 3 started members (node3 with new ID), and both node1 and node3 endpoints return all original application keys

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id f1afbc7f... baseline; systemd-run reboot ack returned before disconnect; post-restart boot_id changed to 3561fa80...; etcd active, 3/3 cluster healthy, all keys present

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id 98aa35f5... baseline; reboot ack returned; post-restart boot_id changed to 266878f5...; etcd active, 3/3 cluster healthy, all keys present

evidence.requirement: node3 (replacement member) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery incl. membership persistence
evidence.summary: boot_id 6bb7e004... baseline; reboot ack returned; post-restart boot_id changed to 3a84d84e...; etcd active, 3/3 cluster healthy, replacement member (5ef59cbc2144a9d) persisted, all keys present including from node3's own endpoint
